messages:
tara: Heads-up — staging rollout of v0.54 shows a clear perf regression, p95 up ~18% for small-batch (batch=8, seq=512) text-generation paths. Blocking prod rollout. https://ci.redwood/.../job/infra-perf-staging/842
aj: I see the CI alert on the perf dashboard. Looks concentrated on fp16 matmul path. No change in request mix.
mike: I ran a quick local run and nvtx traces — the matmul kernel time jumped. Could be kernel selection algo change.
lina: paste the nvprof output?
mike: ```
# nsight-sys summary
Kernel: matmul_small_batched_fp16  calls: 120  avg: 0.42ms  prev: 0.23ms  total: 50.4ms
Kernel: matmul_large_fp32        calls: 10   avg: 2.1ms   prev: 2.0ms   total: 21.0ms
# note: before merge avg for small_batched was ~0.22ms
```
aj: Running git bisect across runtime merges from last week now. Early result: bad commit 3f9a8c2 — message "triton: adapt matmul heuristic for mixed-shapes"
tara: hmm that PR also touched KV-cache batching heuristics, right? Could be an interaction.
mike: Repro matrix: CUDA 12.3.1 + PyTorch 2.2.3 + Triton 2.2.0 -> bad. With CUDA 12.2 + same stack -> perf baseline. So driver/toolkit bump might expose a heuristic fallback difference.
lina: Do we have the exact algo chosen before/after? ncu should show cublas/cublasLt algo id.
mike: Ran ncu: before (good): cublasLt algo 3 selected. after (bad): cublasLt algo 12 selected and higher workspace -> slower for small workloads.
aj: infra-bot: perf/regression detected job=infra-perf-staging/842 metric=p95 delta=+18% link=https://ci.redwood/.../842
infra-bot: @eng-runtime tagging owners for investigation :mag:
tara: Options: 1) pin CUDA/toolkit on infra to 12.2 (fast rollback) 2) revert 3f9a8c2 heuristic change (slower, requires PR) 3) add runtime override to force preferred algo for small matmul (quick config change).
lina: I tried forcing cublasLt algo by setting TRITON_ALGO_OVERRIDE=3 in the runtime env, microbench: p95 returns to baseline (within 2%). Snippet: 
```bash
export TRITON_ALGO_OVERRIDE=3
./bench_small_matmul --batch 8 --seq 512 --dtype fp16
# result: p95 22.4ms (baseline 22.0ms) vs 26.1ms on bad
```
aj: Nice. Which nodes will pick that up? We can push as a staged canary flag to staging pools.
mike: I'll craft a tiny config patch to set TRITON_MATMUL_HEUR=prefer_algo_3 on staging only. That should be non-invasive.
tara: Please do the canary. Also open a revert PR for 3f9a8c2 and link the bisect output + ncu traces so we can decide long-term plan with Triton upstream.
aj: Pushed canary config -> https://infra.redwood/configs/patch/589. Staging now showing p95 back to baseline on the perf job I reran.
ci-bot: perf job infra-perf-staging/845 finished. metric=p95 diff=-1.2% relative to baseline. Passing thresholds.
lina: Great. I've opened revert PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/2739 with description and attach nvprof/ncu artifacts. Assigned to @mike for follow-up with Triton.
mike: I'll take it. Next steps: (A) follow up with Triton maintainers to understand why cublasLt algo choice changed with 12.3.1; (B) propose a more robust heuristic (workspace-aware for small batches) or keep a config knob; (C) decide whether to keep the heuristic revert after Triton fix.
tara: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread updated. Action items: mike -> triage upstream + update PR; aj -> monitor canary rollout and gate prod; lina -> add postmortem doc template and attach traces.
aj: noted. I'll hold prod rollout until we mark the revert PR/larger fix resolved. :white_check_mark:
lina: I'll start the postmortem draft and drop links to the ncu logs and bisect steps.
mike: Quick note for record: bisect commands used: `git bisect start HEAD origin/main -- runtimes && git bisect bad && git bisect good 1f2b3c` -> bad at 3f9a8c2. Attached bisect log to PR.
tara: Closing loop: staging stable with override, prod rollout blocked until revert decision. Thanks! :thumbsup:
